captions.detailed: A 3D-printable six-sided gaming die featuring heavily rounded edges and corners. The body of the die is a cube whose edges have been smoothed and chamfered, transitioning into a slightly spherical profile. Each face features spherical, indented pips arranged in standard dice configurations from 1 to 6.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric six-sided die in OpenSCAD with customizable size. The die should feature smooth, rounded edges and corners, and use spherical indentations for the pips on all six sides, arranged in standard configurations.
captions.factory: The main die body is constructed using an intersection of a central cube, three orthogonal cylinders, and a large sphere to achieve the highly rounded, chamfered corner shape. A difference operation then subtracts small, translated spheres from each of the six faces. The pips are positioned using nested for-loops and rotational offsets to cover all standard layouts (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6).
